choice.basis: The chart displays a comparison of 'High fibre breakfast cereals' (red dashed line, left axis) versus 'Other breakfast cereals' (blue solid line, right axis). For the 11-18 years category, the red line (High fibre) reaches its peak value, while the blue line (Other) reaches its lowest point. This indicates that high-fibre cereals are the dominant or most relevant category for this age group in the context of the comparison. Therefore, the high-fibre category is the appropriate one to route for the specific 'adolescent fibre-support follow-up'.
choice.option_label: Route high-fibre breakfast cereals for 11-18 years to adolescent fibre-support follow-up
